notes:
- Several printers: add each U1 with a name and its IP in Settings → Printers (e.g. "U1 Quarto", "U1 Sala"). Your current U1 is already there as "My U1" — rename it if you like.
- Bambu Handy style selector: on the phone, tap the printer name at the top to switch; on the computer, use the list at the top of the Device tab. Camera, filaments, temperatures and controls follow the printer you pick.
- Choose the printer for each plate: when you print a plate, pick which U1 prints it. Its filaments load right away, so the colors match that printer.
- Two plates of the same project can print at the same time on two printers, each with its own Stop button.
- Alerts (phone, Telegram, computer) say which printer finished or had a problem. /status and /photo on Telegram show every printer.
